MP Ravi Kishan Mistakenly Calls Gorakhpur 'Spain' in Speech

During a public address, Member of Parliament Ravi Kishan mistakenly referred to his constituency, Gorakhpur, as 'Spain'. This gaffe occurred in the presence of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, who was seen laughing. The incident was widely shared and commented on by social media users.
